free_tier.stated: no free tier; the entry plan is 'VPS - 1 ... 147 TL/Aylik' for 1 GB

retention.stated: the disk persists while the plan is paid; no deletion clock is published on the plan page

egress.terms: 'Limitsiz Trafik' - unlimited traffic on a 10 Gbit/s port, stated on every plan card

interface_detail: the plan card states 'Tam Root Erisimi' (full root access), a /64 IPv6, rDNS management and API access
tooling: any SSH client; the vendor's own order panel
chaining: a 2 GB box on a 10 Gbit/s port with unlimited traffic in Istanbul; the cheapest shape here with a port that large, which suits a VPN node better than the RAM figure suggests

limits.value: unlimited traffic on a 10 Gbit/s shared port; no fair-use figure is published

binding_note: traffic is unlimited and the port is 10 Gbit/s, so the shared CPU is the only published throttle; 2 GB is the real ceiling at this price.

identity_cost.detail: The vendor publishes an Istanbul address and an 0850 support number.

confidence_note: shape, the TRY price, the USD price the vendor also displays, and the traffic term are quoted from the vendor's own plan list read. The identity and payment fields are unverified.

Netlen is the only host that publishes a 10 Gbit/s port on a sub-USD-4 plan. Not established: payment rails and any card hold, and whether the 10 Gbit/s is per-VM or a shared uplink.

extras.price_arithmetic: 197 TRY/Aylik, times 0.020107 USD per TRY = USD 3.96 a month. The hourly alternative is 0.30 TRY x 730 = 219 TRY, so the monthly cap binds and is cheaper.
extras.renewal_note: no promo is shown on the plan card; 197 TRY is the list price
